description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). One pack file's upload. action start {name, bytes, sha256}: have:true, or an upload id with part URLs (a second start of the same file resumes and lists the parts already there). action urls {upload_id, parts}: more part URLs. action complete {upload_id}: checks every part, the size, the bytes' hash (files up to 64 MiB), disc images and retail files, then stores it. action abort {upload_id}.

name.description: start: the file name mod.json uses (a flat name).

parts.description: urls: the part numbers to get URLs for (at most 100).

slug.description: The YG Dolphin listing's slug: the last part of https://yougame.co/g/<slug>.

upload_id.description: urls, complete, abort: from start's answer.

name: pack_file
